object_name: inspection_templates.sections normalization
detail: Anonymous DO $$ plpgsql block: loops over all inspection_templates WHERE sections IS NOT NULL. If jsonb_typeof(sections)='array': for each element missing/empty 'name', backfills name via jsonb_set from a prettified form of the element's 'id' (regexp_replace(initcap(replace(id,'_',' ')), '([A-Z])', ' \1', 'g')) falling back to 'Unnamed Section'. If jsonb_typeof(sections)='object' (legacy format): converts each key/value pair to an array element jsonb_build_object('id', key, 'name', COALESCE(value->>'name', prettified key), 'order_index', COALESCE((value->>'order_index')::integer, 0), 'items', COALESCE(value->'items','[]'::jsonb)). If the normalized array is non-empty, UPDATE inspection_templates SET sections = normalized_sections WHERE id = template_record.id. Pure data migration — converts legacy object-shaped sections to array shape and guarantees every section has a name. RAISE NOTICE per template.

object_name: validate_inspection_templates
detail: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION validate_inspection_templates() RETURNS TABLE (template_id uuid, template_name text, issue_type text, issue_description text) LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public. Read-only diagnostic: UNION ALL of three checks against inspection_templates: (1) 'Structure' issues via CTE template_analysis (sections IS NULL / not array / empty array); (2) 'Missing Name' for array sections where section->>'name' IS NULL or ''; (3) 'Duplicate ID' for section IDs appearing more than once (note: this first version filters duplicates with WHERE id_count > 1 outside the aggregate, without HAVING — replaced by next migration). COMMENT ON FUNCTION: 'Validates the structure and integrity of inspection templates'. Tables touched: inspection_templates (SELECT only).

Corrected rewrite of the previous migration's function (same signature, same SECURITY DEFINER): (1) 'Structure' check now a direct SELECT with WHERE sections IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(sections) != 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(sections) = 0 and an ELSE 'Unknown structure issue' branch; (2) 'Missing Name' check unchanged in substance; (3) 'Duplicate ID' check fixed to use GROUP BY ... HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 in the subquery and reports the count: format('Section ID "%s" appears %s times', section_id, id_count). COMMENT ON FUNCTION re-applied: 'Validates the structure and integrity of inspection templates'. Tables touched: inspection_templates (SELECT only).

object_name: get_rls_policies_for_role
detail: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_rls_policies_for_role(role_name text) RETURNS TABLE(table_name text, policy_name text, command text, using_expression text, with_check_expression text) LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_catalog. Behavior: introspection query over pg_policies WHERE schemaname = 'public' AND (policyname ILIKE '%' || role_name || '%' OR policyname ILIKE '%authenticated%' OR (role_name = 'Admin' AND policyname ILIKE '%admin%') OR (role_name = 'Client' AND policyname ILIKE '%client%') OR (role_name = 'Contractor' AND policyname ILIKE '%contractor%')); returns tablename, policyname, cmd, COALESCE(qual::text,''), COALESCE(with_check::text,''); ORDER BY tablename, cmd, policyname. Matching is name-pattern based, not role-membership based. No GRANT/REVOKE statement in this migration (default function EXECUTE privileges apply). Tables touched: pg_catalog.pg_policies (SELECT only).

object_name: (dynamic: all storage.objects policies with name LIKE '%documents%' or '%document%')
detail: DO $$ block: loops over pg_policies WHERE tablename='objects' AND schemaname='storage' AND (policyname LIKE '%documents%' OR policyname LIKE '%document%'), executing DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON storage.objects for each. Drops every document-related storage policy, including the per-role documents-bucket policies created in 20251120051502.

object_name: documents
detail: UPDATE storage.buckets SET public = true WHERE id = 'documents'. Makes the documents bucket publicly readable via public object URLs.

object_name: Public can view documents

object_name: (dynamic: ALL policies on storage.objects)
detail: DO $$ block: loops over pg_policies WHERE tablename='objects' AND schemaname='storage' (no name filter), executing DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON storage.objects for each. Drops every storage policy in the database, including all bucket-scoped per-role policies from 20251120051502 and the documents policies from 20251120081347.

object_name: (all buckets)
detail: UPDATE storage.buckets SET public = true (no WHERE clause). Every storage bucket — including profile-images, inspection-photos, site-images, documents and any others — becomes publicly readable.

object_name: Authenticated users full access to all buckets - SELECT

object_name: Authenticated users full access to all buckets - INSERT
detail: FOR INSERT, no TO clause (applies to PUBLIC). WITH CHECK (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL). No bucket_id filter.

object_name: Authenticated users full access to all buckets - UPDATE
detail: FOR UPDATE, no TO clause (applies to PUBLIC). USING (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL). No bucket_id filter, no WITH CHECK clause.

object_name: Authenticated users full access to all buckets - DELETE
detail: FOR DELETE, no TO clause (applies to PUBLIC). USING (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL). No bucket_id filter.

object_name: Public can view all buckets
detail: FOR SELECT, no TO clause (applies to PUBLIC, including anon). USING (true). Anonymous read of every object in every bucket.

object_name: (dynamic: ALL policies on storage.objects)
detail: DO $$ block: loops over pg_policies WHERE tablename='objects' AND schemaname='storage' (no name filter), executing DROP POLICY IF EXISTS %I ON storage.objects for each. Drops all storage policies again, including those created minutes earlier in 20251120083541.

detail: FOR SELECT, no TO clause (applies to PUBLIC, including anon). USING (true). No authentication required.

object_name: Anyone can upload to all storage
detail: FOR INSERT, no TO clause (applies to PUBLIC, including anon). WITH CHECK (true). Anonymous users can upload to any bucket.

object_name: Anyone can update all storage
detail: FOR UPDATE, no TO clause (applies to PUBLIC, including anon). USING (true). No WITH CHECK clause. Anonymous users can overwrite any object.

object_name: Anyone can delete from all storage
detail: FOR DELETE, no TO clause (applies to PUBLIC, including anon). USING (true). Anonymous users can delete any object in any bucket.
